_comment: Curated observation proxies (#767), read by src/weatherbrief/analysis/obs_proxy.py. Field ICAO -> stations tried in order, for both METAR and TAF (a list), or per kind ({"metar": [...], "taf": [...]}; a kind left out uses the automatic pick: <= 10 NM METAR / <= 15 NM TAF, |elevation diff| <= 100 ft). An override replaces the automatic pick: it skips the distance and elevation gates, still needs a METAR <= 90 min old or a TAF valid at ETA, and nothing else is tried when none qualifies.
